"have a look"                                        printing=false piped=false allowed
"-p have a look"                                     printing=true  piped=false allowed
"--print have a look"                                printing=true  piped=false allowed
"-p"                                                 printing=true  piped=false a printed session needs a prompt
"-p"                                                 printing=true  piped=true  allowed
"-p -r"                                              printing=true  piped=false a printed session cannot open a picker; name the session or the model instead
"-p -m"                                              printing=true  piped=false a printed session cannot open a picker; name the session or the model instead
"-p -r"                                              printing=true  piped=true  a printed session cannot open a picker; name the session or the model instead
"-p -r chosen-lobster have a look"                   printing=true  piped=false allowed
"-p -m codex/gpt-5.3-codex@high have a look"         printing=true  piped=false allowed
"-p --from chosen-lobster"                           printing=true  piped=false allowed
